summary: This is a shelf takedown prospectus supplement filed by Perma-Fix Environmental Services, Inc. under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of 2,285,714 shares of common stock at $8.75 per share, with a 30-day over-allotment option for 342,857 additional shares. The offering price represents a ~9.8% discount to the last sale price of $9.70 on May 13, 2026. Gross proceeds are ~$20M before underwriting discounts of ~$1.4M, and Craig-Hallum is the sole underwriter. Use of proceeds is not detailed in the excerpt. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, as it merely dilutes existing holders to fund general corporate purposes. No activist, strategic review, M&A, or capital return event is implicated.
